name: list_main_services
description: Provides information about the main services offered by the Ayuntamiento de Morón de la Frontera, including hours and methods for making appointments.

outputs.description: Details on in-person and phone assistance hours
Describes methods for scheduling appointments (online, phone, in-person)

children.name: prompt_for_appointment_selection
children.description: Prompts the user to select a type of appointment from available options.

parameters.name: selected_appointment_type
parameters.description: Represents the choice of appointment the user wants to schedule

outputs.description: Options for types of appointments (Cita con el alcalde, Cita con Urbanismo, Cita con el SAC)

children.name: provide_mayor_appointment_info
children.description: Provides information on how to request a mayor's appointment, including available scheduling methods.

outputs.description: Includes options for requesting appointments either online through the electronic headquarters or in person at the Citizen Attention Service (SAC).

children.name: prompt_for_identification_access
children.description: Asks the user to access the electronic identification process for making online appointments by directing them to the relevant website.

children.name: present_electronic_headquarters_link
children.description: Provides the user with a link to access the electronic headquarters or office of the Ayuntamiento.

outputs.description: URL to the electronic office headquarters site for the Ayuntamiento.

children.name: provide_urbanism_appointment_info
children.description: Provides detailed information on how to schedule an appointment with the Urbanism department, including methods and location details.

outputs.description: Methods for scheduling an appointment, which includes electronic platforms, phone, or in-person visits, along with location details of the Urbanism department.
The physical address of the Urbanism department for in-person visits: Edificio de las Filipenses, calle Cantarranas, número 33, Morón de la Frontera.

name: provide_complaint_submission_information
description: Informs the user about the process to submit a complaint or claim, including instructions for filling out a General Instance and options for submission methods, both in-person and online.

outputs.description: Options for submitting a complaint, including in-person at the Registry and online through the Electronic Headquarters with a digital certificate. Provides instructions and information on how to submit complaints or claims electronically as well as specific requirements.
URL for accessing the Electronic Headquarters for submissions.

name: provide_municipal_corporation_information
description: The chatbot provides information about the current government team and municipal groups represented in the Ayuntamiento.

outputs.description: Details about the ruling party and other represented groups, along with a link to the municipal corporation information.

name: provide_tax_payment_deadlines
description: The chatbot informs the user about the deadlines for paying municipal taxes based on different fractions and types of taxes.

name: provide_contact_information_for_sae
description: Provides details on how to contact the Servicio Andaluz de Empleo (SAE) through various channels, including information on scheduling appointments and service hours.

outputs.description: Information about operating hours for in-person and telephone services.
Instructions on how to schedule an appointment, including options via electronic office, phone, in-person, and telephone methods.

name: provide_basic_information_about_unemployment_services
description: The chatbot provides guidance and information regarding types of assistance available for individuals in unemployment situations and directs them to appropriate services.

outputs.description: Information about the types of assistance available for unemployed individuals, including guidance on services from the Servicio Andaluz de Empleo and options for evaluating existing circumstances regarding unemployment support.
Details on how to contact the SAE and the central office for further assistance.

name: present_ayuntamiento_website_link
description: Provides a direct link to the Ayuntamiento's website for additional information.

outputs.description: Direct URL to the Ayuntamiento's website.
